reviews.title: No real customer support
reviews.text:
I canceled my 14-day TalkPal AI trial after 10 days because I wasn’t using it as much as other tools for learning Italian. The app was okay, but its responses felt generic and didn’t adapt well to how I learn.

Despite canceling before the trial ended, I was charged $89.99. I contacted support and provided a screenshot of the charge, but the replies kept saying they couldn’t find a charge associated with my email address. I have yet to receive an explanation or a refund.

I would have rated the app itself two stars. The billing issue and lack of helpful support bring my overall rating to one star.

reviews.title: Better apps
reviews.text: I thought this would be an amazing app because it actually has European Portuguese but I was wrong. You only get 10 minutes of learning every day. Instead of being helpful, it only spoke to me in Portuguese and its really hard to have a conversation that doesn’t feel like talking to an AI. I wanted an app that I can learn what I want but I guess I will have to keep looking.

reviews.title: Very Good
reviews.text: I recommend it for the languages I’m using it for, but with one strong caveat: for whatever reason, the app is not geared towards people who are just learning a new language. It seems to be more for people who are familiar with the language (both in written and spoken forms) and don’t need explanations on some of the finer points of why and when to use certain things. That said, the app is excellent. It’s the 4-5 different language-learning app I’ve used. None of the previous have worked as well as Talkpal in the sense that I’m building my speaking and listening skills congruently.

Also, it would be nice if there were per-language settings so one doesn’t have to manually change their skill level every time they hop between languages.

reviews.title: Best SPEAKING App Ever!
reviews.text: I am a lower intermediate level and needed to speak more. After trying several Apps and even joining a live Spanish-Speaking course, I still did not receive sufficient speaking time or grammar feedback to help me move forward. ChatGPT recommended Talkpal, which I never heard of, and I have been using it for 65 days consecutively. This App is just awesome. You get unlimited opportunities to speak without a script and you get many opportunities to speak with a script as well as to perfect your diction and grammar. Plus, there are many different Topics which allow you to reinforce your vocabulary with pre-scripted and un-scripted lessons. Plus, the App offers a variety of learning methods-word practice, sentence practice, etc. This is good for me since I get bored easily. I wish I had found this App when I started learning Spanish. It is awesome and I have seen a drastic improvement in my speaking ability. Thank you!

reviews.title: Chat mode
reviews.text: I need to practice Spanish for conversations. So I tried chat mode. It is very difficult to understand because it speaks so quickly. When I ask it to slow down, it says it understands, but it keeps speaking as quickly as before. In addition it uses words and conjugations I don’t understand. I try to ask it to speak to me like a child, using smaller, more understandable words, but it doesn’t do that. It just keeps speaking the same style and the same things over and over. I don’t understand why it won’t change to speak in ways I can understand - slowly and simply. It’s frustrating.

reviews.title: Great AI tutor!
reviews.text:
I’ve been using Talkpal AI for language learning, and honestly, it’s been a game changer for me. The convenience alone makes it easy to stay consistent—I can practice anytime without needing to schedule anything or rely on someone else.

What I really love is the constant exposure to the language. Instead of just memorizing words, I’m actually seeing and using them in real examples, which makes everything stick so much better. The app does a great job of teaching through context rather than just drills.

The real-time feedback is another huge plus. It helps me catch mistakes immediately and improve on the spot, which makes every session feel productive. It’s like having a patient tutor available 24/7.

Overall, Talkpal AI makes language learning feel natural, flexible, and actually enjoyable. Highly recommend it to anyone trying to build real confidence in a new language.
